data.one_liner: A chunk uploader for Flutter based on the JS library UpChunk.
data.what_it_does: Flutter UpChunk allows you to upload large files in chunks to a given endpoint with support for pauses, resumes, retries, and progress tracking.
use_when: You need to upload large files in chunks to avoid request timeouts or size limits.
You want built-in retry logic, pausing, and resuming for file uploads.
avoid_when: You are doing simple single-request file uploads where standard HTTP POST/PUT suffices.
strengths: Supports chunked uploading with configurable chunk sizes and retry attempts.
Provides pause, resume, restart, and stop controls.
Supports web, mobile, and desktop platforms.
weaknesses: Relies on specific server-side support for chunked PUT requests.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general-purpose HTTP requests and advanced interceptor support if chunking is not strictly required.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple core networking tasks without extra chunking logic.
